name: contexttrail
description: ContextTrail — reconstruct the web history of an image. Image-first v1 frontend.

scripts.watchlists: tsc --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2020 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --strict --outDir .watchlists-build scripts/watchlists.ts && node .watchlists-build/scripts/watchlists.js
scripts.inquiries: tsc --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2020 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --strict --outDir .inquiries-build scripts/inquiries.ts && node .inquiries-build/scripts/inquiries.js
scripts.source-dependencies: tsc --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2020 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --strict --outDir .source-dependencies-build scripts/source-dependencies.ts && node .source-dependencies-build/scripts/source-dependencies.js
scripts.media:match: tsc --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2020 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --strict --outDir .media-match-build scripts/match-media.ts && node .media-match-build/scripts/match-media.js
scripts.media:evaluate: tsc --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2020 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --strict --outDir .media-match-build scripts/evaluate-media-matching.ts && node .media-match-build/scripts/evaluate-media-matching.js
